description: The DGFI-TUM TICON collection provides harmonic tidal constants derived from GESLA sea-level observations. Its original product contains 40 constituents for 1,145 gauges; TICON-3 extends this to 3,471 gauges and adds coastal, river or lake classifications. The companion TICON-td product estimates four third-degree constituents at 134 selected ocean gauges. PANGAEA offers downloadable tab-separated text files free under CC-BY-4.0. Fields include amplitude, phase, standard deviations, observation counts, missing-data percentage, gaps and source-series dates. These estimates can validate tidal simulations and define coastal water-level components for ports, flood defences and offshore infrastructure. They are derived from GESLA, not replacing its measured time series. Coverage varies by gauge and product. TICON-3 excludes records shorter than a year or with inadequate valid observations; TICON-td applies different, stricter screening. The provider describes thirteen columns for TICON-3 but enumerates fourteen, including gauge type, so users should inspect the actual header before import.
